Metadata.Goal: 让 CLI、TUI 与 headless conversation 通过同一 native workflow component/tools 完成 authoring 与 runtime lifecycle。
Metadata.Description: Terminal native-tool port、CLI runtime commands、自然语言路由与跨入口恢复验收。

TaskSpace.name: verify-eidolon-workflow-cross-surface-acceptance
TaskSpace.Description: One native workflow capability across terminal surfaces.

TaskGroup.name: Terminal native tool bridge
TaskGroup.Description: Expose standardized native tool invocation through the existing runtime session.

Task.name: Add runtime bridge native tool port
Task.Description: Invoke assembled native tools with live VM/actor and persist through the coordinator.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Terminal runtime exposes a generic tested native-tool invocation port

Task.name: Add workspace-scoped organ-support adapter
Task.Description: Configure, recover, invoke and dispose a deterministic workflow session.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Separate invocations resolve the same workspace-scoped session authority

TaskGroup.name: Human-facing lifecycle commands
TaskGroup.Description: Project existing workflow tools into CLI and conversation guidance.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Every CLI lifecycle command calls exactly one corresponding native tool

Task.name: Extend ordinary-language conversation routing
Task.Description: Route lifecycle and graph correction language through high-level tools.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Kernel guidance covers create/edit/run/status/events/result/resume/patch without internal syntax requirements

TaskGroup.name: Cross-surface verification
TaskGroup.Description: Prove wiring, recovery, builds and authority constraints.

Task.name: Run focused CLI TUI and runtime tests
Task.Description: Verify tool mapping, stable sessions, roots, recovery and compiled binaries.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Focused tests and compiled CLI/TUI builds pass

Task.name: Audit authority and forbidden paths
Task.Description: Confirm no CLI-private runtime/parser/file writer, no MCP and no external agent CLI.

cdt:Acceptance.cdt:Criterion: Static audit finds only component/tool projections
